name: Write and debug MATLAB code for technical simulations
description: Users requested the creation, implementation, and analysis of MATLAB code or Simulink models for a wide range of technical domains, including signal processing, optimization algorithms, robotics, physics simulations, and machine learning. These requests often involved writing functions from scratch, translating mathematical concepts into executable scripts, generating visualizations, or debugging existing scripts to resolve specific runtime errors.
